limitations: Only source shape and explicit argv binding are checked by the reference; no shell parser, dependency resolver or ambient-environment proof is implemented.
The actual-source comparison checks source shapes, not effective Make expansion or CI execution.
Generated requirements exports and deliberately isolated cohorts must be identified from real executable owners; they are not blanket exclusions for arbitrary duplicate authorities.
